```plato

    //==
    // # ColorXYZ — the INumerical obligations, component-wise over X/Y/Z
    //
    // Tristimulus values are a linear space by construction: CIE XYZ is defined
    // as an integral against the colour matching functions, so summing two
    // colours' tristimulus values is summing their spectra, and scaling is
    // scaling the radiance. That makes the component-wise arithmetic below
    // physically meaningful, unlike the same operations on a gamma-encoded or
    // perceptual space — which is exactly why ColorLab and friends next door are
    // plain `IValue` and get no arithmetic.

    // Component-wise sum: the tristimulus of the combined spectra.
    Add(a: ColorXYZ, b: ColorXYZ): ColorXYZ
        => (a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y, a.Z + b.Z);
```
